# Ep128web

> Enterprise 128/64 and Videoton TVC emulator (ep128emu compiled to WebAssembly) in the
> browser. The page can be driven from code: the global `window.ep` object starts
> machines, loads programs and ROMs, types, reads the screen as text, runs a fixed number
> of frames, gives full debugger access (registers, memory, breakpoints, disassembly,
> ep128emu monitor commands) and saves / restores the machine state.

- [Automation API (window.ep)](https://github.com/kks2003/Ep128web/blob/main/docs/AUTOMATION.md): every function with examples (Playwright, browser console, debugger scripts)
- [README (Hungarian)](https://github.com/kks2003/Ep128web/blob/main/README.md): features, file types, keyboard shortcuts, building

## Essentials

- Wait for the page: `await page.waitForFunction(() => window.ep)`, then `await ep.ready()` (BASIC shows "ok").
- `await ep.machine('tvc64-12' | 'tvc64p-22' | 'ep128uk-exdos' | …)` – list: `ep.machines()`.
- `await ep.load(url | bytes, name)` – programs start by themselves; ROM package: `ep128emu_roms-2.0.11.bin`.
- `await ep.type('PRINT 1+1\n')`, `ep.screenText()`, `await ep.waitText(/regexp/)`, `ep.runFrames(n)`.
- Debugger: `ep.regs()`, `ep.read(addr, n)`, `ep.disasm(addr, n)`, `ep.bp(addr)`, `ep.onBreak(fn)`, `ep.monitor('?')`.
